# Matthew C. Wright Music API

> Original music for automated creative workflows, with downloadable audio and attribution.

- [Agent guide](https://api.matthewcwright.com/developers/agent-guide.md): Authentication, search, downloads, credits, limits, and retries.
- [OpenAPI definition](https://api.matthewcwright.com/developers/openapi.json): Machine-readable v1 API contract.
- [Developer account](https://api.matthewcwright.com/developers/): Email-link sign-in and API-key management.
- [Music catalog](https://matthewcwright.com/music/royalty-free/): Browse the public music collection.

Connect an AI app to https://api.matthewcwright.com/mcp using Streamable HTTP and OAuth.
Scripts use an API key stored in their secret settings. Never paste credentials
into chat or forward them to audio downloads. Both share account usage limits.
